title: Coloring-allowed Invariants and the 4-phases Functions of Knotoids
summary: In recent years, numerous polynomial invariants of knotoids have been constructed, some of which are defined with the signs of the crossings. In this paper, the coloring-allowed invariants of planar knotoids, which is a class of planar knotoid invariants defined with the coloring number are introduced. We demonstrate several basic properties of the coloring number and some examples of coloring-allowed invariants, among which the 4-phases functions are discussed in detail, including their invariance and properties.
